agent_priors_used: GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): an operational failure that carries only an exit code and a failure fingerprint - a retryable install failure or a shared design-review model routing fault - is an infrastructure event, not scientific evidence, and must not redirect research. Repair the shared component once instead of letting each lane re-discover the same absence.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose comparators sit at the correctness ceiling has zero dynamic range and cannot detect a treatment effect even if the treatment is good; dynamic range must be certified before freeze, and repeated unsatisfiable certificates must not be re-purchased.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): prompt/instruction specification and model capability are separate failure modes; a 0/N result produced under an underspecified prompt is not yet a capability bound, and a capability gate should precede any full four-arm economics benchmark.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): long-lived research agents over-exploit their deepest local thread (local-attractor / tunnel behavior); a global director should remove one shared blocker once rather than let each lane continue a mature thread past the point where the next result can still change a decision.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): deterministic record/replay and workflow compilation win on periodic or templatable tasks and degrade on novel, stateful or drifting ones; the durable value is at the residual-novelty boundary, so replay speed is not the product metric.

GENERAL PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): cross-site / cross-app generalization is more robust via structural or layout abstractions than via element identity or literal routes - a candidate Frontier direction, not an established SPIDER result.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. allocation.question: Can a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified arithmetically BEFORE freeze - with cold re-derivation and a retrieval-shaped comparator demonstrably below the success ceiling at high residual novelty (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on at least one task family, matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms), a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction, honest per-condition counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate - and be delivered as a reusable substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (B2), recording a bounded substrate-class negative (and freezing nothing) if the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested, on a substrate materially different from the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class (multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks; a fourth re-run of the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate is explicitly excluded)?
allocation.rationale: This is the single highest-leverage unblock in the program: the 2026-10-10 global audit names B2 - a task bank where cold and retrieval are not pinned at the 1.0 correctness ceiling - as the prerequisite that makes SPIDER's central cost-per-success claim even measurable. The active PREFREEZE experiment EXP-RUNTIME-38110505221 is UNFINISHED and its only recorded failure is the shared design-review model routing fault (opencode/exo-free, exit_code 1), an operational control-plane defect, not a scientific result; its model_design.json completed. The lane's C-MEAS-VALID concentration (10/10 recent, claim_streak 68, tunnel_flag true) is a real local-attractor indicator, but a cognitive reset still selects this packet: the current mandate explicitly SUPERSEDES the repeated oracle out-of-surface re-validation (the parent EXP-RUNTIME-37973247935) in favour of substrate engineering for B2, so the flag does not force a pivot away from the right work. After it, residual measurement questions should be farmed to the lanes that need them rather than re-validating the bounded C-MEAS-VALID ceiling again.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The blocker architecture of the 2026-10-10 global audit (B1 no shipped parameterized carrier, B2 non-degenerate task bank, B3 capable/credentialed agent endpoint) is unchanged by any accepted evidence since the last cycle, and all six scientific lanes hold an unfinished experiment, so nothing is dormant. The decisive new information this cycle is OPERATIONAL, not scientific, and I verified it at source in the lane branches: every active experiment now carries a failure receipt. Graph EXP-GRAPH-38110498641 failed at the install stage (OPENCODE_INSTALL_FAILURE, exit 75, retryable) with spec.json still PENDING and zero measurement taken. Physics EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597 is FROZEN but failed at execute (EXECUTION_FAILURE, exit 1). Runtime EXP-RUNTIME-38110505221, Product EXP-PRODUCT-38110508898, Intel EXP-INTEL-38110512532 and Frontier EXP-FRONTIER-38085197666 each completed model_design.json and then failed the independent design-review stage with the IDENTICAL signature (model opencode/exo-free, exit_code 1, attempt 4, category substantive, same control_revision bfa3c519) - one shared control-plane review-model routing fault, not four scientific negatives. No lane has produced a single measurement this cycle. The correct global response is therefore to PRESERVE and RESUME the exact in-flight mandates rather than re-derive directions from infrastructure noise: all six lanes receive CONTINUE on their current claims. I explicitly decline three tempting redirections: (a) no funding of the expensive four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmarks, because none of the three readiness conditions holds (B1 carrier not shipped, B2 baselines still at ceiling on the deterministic REST class, B3 no capable endpoint); (b) no re-litigation of the parked four-anchor C-FRESHNESS D1V route, which its own evidence closed as single-anchor and transport-coupled; (c) no new physics cosmology beyond the already-frozen barrier-stationarity packet. C-DELTA-REPAIR remains the most starved live claim (1 recent experiment, last attempt 2026-09-25) and is a genuine REOPEN candidate, but it is deliberately DEFERRED - not terminated - until the graph semantic thread reaches a clean scientific result or fails for a genuinely scientific (not control-plane) reason. The recurring shared design-review/install failure is one control-plane component to repair once; it is not evidence about any claim and must not be converted into a research conclusion.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout is NOT degraded this cycle (model_scout.json exit 0), and its spider_evidence is a faithful restatement of the machine snapshot and effective claim state; I independently converged on the same B1/B2/B3 blocker structure before reading it. It affected the decision in three bounded ways: (1) it reinforced that the only high-leverage near-term moves are the B1 carrier install, the B2 non-degenerate task bank, and the B3 capability gate, which are exactly the in-flight Product/Runtime/Intel mandates, so no new direction is needed; (2) its external non-degenerate benchmark options (Online-Mind2Web / WebGym / WebChoreArena) are useful design input for Runtime's B2 certificate but are external context, not SPIDER evidence, and browser-use already reports ~98% on Online-Mind2Web, so ceiling risk must be measured rather than assumed - I did not let it justify any allocation change; (3) its MemStrata structural-supersession finding is a plausible future reframe for C-FRESHNESS, but no ready non-four-anchor freshness test exists and the D1V route is parked by its own evidence, so I did not reopen it. The Scout materially UNDER-weighted the operational fact that is decisive this cycle - the shared design-review model routing failure across four lanes - which is why its questions_for_director read as science questions rather than liveness questions; I answered them as 'resume the unfinished mandates, do not re-run, and do not fund the flagship benchmark.' I declined its parallel Frontier structural-sketch suggestion while the C-CROSSSITE v2 design is unfinished.
